He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]]. ==High school career== Hagans attended [[Newton High School (Georgia)|Newton High School]] in [[Covington, Georgia]] where he averaged 20.2 points, 10.7 assists, 7.6 rebounds and 3.6 steals per game as a junior. He earned [[Mr. Basketball]] in Georgia as well as the Gatorade Georgia Player of the Year honors.{{cite news|title=Get to know new Minnesota Timberwolves guard Ashton Hagans|url=https://www.foxsports.com/north/story/get-to-know-new-minnesota-timberwolves-guard-ashton-hagans-kentucky-wildcats-120820|work=[[Fox Sports]]|date=December 8, 2020|access-date=October 21, 2021}} ===Recruiting=== Hagans originally committed to [[Georgia Bulldogs men's basketball|Georgia]] on December 27, 2017. Hagans later decommitted from Georgia on February 26, 2018.{{cite web|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|title=Ashton Hagans decommits from Georgia, AAU coach says|url=http://www.espn.com/college-sports/recruiting/basketball/mens/story/_/id/22587708/five-star-junior-ashton-hagans-decommits-georgia-bulldogs|publisher=[[ESPN]]|date=February 26, 2018|access-date=February 26, 2018}} On April 10, 2018, Hagans committed to play for [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]].{{cite web|first=Kyle|last=Newport|title=5-Star PG Ashton Hagans Commits to Kentucky After Decommitting from Georgia|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2761996-5-star-pg-ashton-hagans-commits-to-kentucky-after-decommitting-from-georgia|publisher=[[Bleacher Report]]|date=April 10, 2018|access-date=April 10, 2018}} On June 15, 2018, Hagans [[reclassification (education)|reclassified]] to the 2018 class, allowing him to enroll at Kentucky.{{cite web|first=Gary|last=Parrish|title=Kentucky lands five-star point guard next season as Ashton Hagans reclassifies to Class of 2018, will enroll at espn overall = 20 | access-date = June 4, 2018 | bball = yes }} ==College career== Hagans made his preseason debut for Kentucky on August 8, 2018, in an 85–61 win over the [[Bahamas national basketball team|Bahamas National Team]], scoring 6 points, collecting 5 rebounds, and 3 steals.{{cite web|first=Tyler|last=Thompson|title=Ashton Hagans on his "amazing" first game as a Wildcat|url=http://kentuckysportsradio.com/basketball-2/ashton-hagans-on-his-amazing-first-game-as-a-wildcat/|publisher=Kentucky Sports Radio|date=August 9, 2018|access-date=August 9, 2018}} On January 15, 2018, he scored 23 points in a 69–49 win over his former committed team, the [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia Bulldogs]].{{cite web|first=Gentry|last=Estes|title=Three takeaways from Kentucky basketball's win over Georgia|url=http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2019/01/15/kentucky-basketball-ashton-hagans-georgia-score-stats/2513694002/|publisher=[[The Courier Journal]]|date=January 15, 2019|access-date=January 15, 2019}} Hagans started the final 29 games of his freshman season and averaged 7.7 points, 4.3 assists, 2.6 rebounds and 1.6 steals per game. His 61 steals was the third highest by a freshman in program history behind [[John Wall]] (66) and [[Rajon Rondo]] (87). He was named [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] Co-Defensive Player of the Year.{{cite news|first=Brad|last=Crawford|title=Look: Kentucky guard Ashton Hagans added serious muscle|url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/Ashton-Hagans-Kentucky-Wildcats-basketball-muscle-weight-room-John-Calipari-133285467/|work=247Sports|date=June 29, 2019|access-date=January 6, 2020}} Hagans suffered an ankle injury in a 71–59 win over [[Missouri Tigers men's basketball|Missouri]] on January 4, 2020.{{cite news|first=Chris|last=Fisher|title=Calipari updates status of Ashton Hagans|url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/Kentucky-basketball-Ashton-Hagans-injury-141635803/|work=247Sports|date=January 4, 2020|access-date=January 6, 2020}} He missed a game against [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]] on March 7 for personal reasons.{{cite news|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|title=Kentucky's Ashton Hagans out for personal reasons|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28857480/kentucky-ashton-hagans-personal-reasons|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 7, 2020|access-date=March 7, 2020}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Hagans was named to the SEC All-Defensive Team.{{cite press release|title=SEC announces 2020 Men's Basketball Awards|url=https://www.secsports.com/article/28877731/sec-announces-2020-men-basketball-awards|publisher=Southeastern Conference|date=March 10, 2020|access-date=March 10, 2020}} He averaged 11.5 points, 3.9 rebounds, 6.4 assists and 1.9 steals per game.{{cite news|first=Chris|last=Fisher|title=Ashton Hagans working out with Tyler Herro|url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/Kentucky-basketball-Ashton-Hagans-working-out-with-Tyler-Herro-145134518/|work=247 Sports|date=March 17, 2020|access-date=March 18, 2020}} Following the season, Hagans declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite news|title=Kentucky guard Ashton Hagans declares for NBA draft|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28997583/kentucky-guard-ashton-hagans-declares-nba-draft|work=[[ESPN]]|date=April 5, 2020|access-date=April 6, 2020}} ==Professional career== ===Minnesota Timberwolves (2020–2021)=== After going undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]], Hagans signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{cite news|first=Jon|last=Hale|title=Report: Ashton Hagans signs contract with Minnesota Timberwolves after going undrafted|url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2020/11/19/ashton-hagans-kentucky-point-guard-signs-minnesota-timberwolves/6308299002/|work=[[The Courier-Journal]]|date=November 19, 2020|access-date=November 19, 2020}} Hagans played two minutes in two games without recording any statistics. On February 13, 2021, the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] waived Hagans for violating [[NBA G League]] COVID protocols.{{cite web|title=Minnesota Timberwolves waive Ashton Hagans|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/minnesota-timberwolves-waive-ashton-hagans|website=NBA.com|date=February 13, 2021|access-date=February 13, 2021}} ===Raptors 905 (2021–2022)=== Hagans was expected to join the [[Toronto Raptors]] in [[2021 NBA Summer League]] but was injured.{{cite web|title=Raptors To Sign, Waive Ashton Hagans, Breein Tyree|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/10/raptors-to-sign-waive-ashton-hagans-breein-tyree.html|work=Hoops Rumors|access-date=October 16, 2021}} He was signed by the Raptors on October 16, 2021, but was waived to join the [[Raptors 905]].{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Raptors To Sign, Waive Ashton Hagans, Breein Tyree|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/10/raptors-to-sign-waive-ashton-hagans-breein-tyree.html|work=Hoops Rumors|date=October 16, 2021|access-date=October 21, 2021}} ===Fort Wayne Mad Ants / Greensboro Swarm (2022–2023)=== On November 18, 2022, Hagans signed with the [[Indiana Mad Ants|Fort Wayne Mad Ants]] after [[David Stockton]] entered health & safety protocols. He was waived 4 days later after appearing in 1 game. He then signed with the [[Greensboro Swarm]], and in his first game with the team, posted a triple-double that included 22 assists, tied for the second-most in G League history.{{cite web|title=Hagans, Greensboro Overwhelms Westchester|url=https://gleague.nba.com/game/gbo-vs-wes-2052200133?view=game-story|website=NBA.com|date=November 28, 2022|access-date=November 29, 2022}} ===Portland Trail Blazers / Rip City Remix (2023–2024)=== On October 1, 2023, Hagans signed with the [[Portland Trail Blazers]], but was waived the same day.{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Trail Blazers Sign, Waive Ashton Hagans|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/10/trail-blazers-to-sign-ashton-hagans.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|access-date=October 1, 2023|date=October 1, 2023}} On October 30, he joined the [[Rip City Remix]].{{cite tweet|first=Casey|last=Holdahl|title=The @ripcityremix begin training camp for their {{as written|ina|gural [sic]}} season today at the @trailblazers practice facility. Here's who they're taking into camp...|number=1719017456981696590|user=CHold|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=November 12, 2023}} On February 8, 2024, Hagans signed a 10-day contract with the [[Portland Trail Blazers]]{{cite web|title=Trail Blazers Sign Ashton Hagans to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-ashton-hagans-to-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=February 8, 2024|access-date=February 8, 2024}} and on February 18, he returned to the Remix.{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Rip City Remix Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Rip-City-Remix/67/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=February 19, 2024}} On February 23, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Trail Blazers.{{cite web|first=Fernando|last=Gomez|title=Trail Blazers Sign Ashton Hagans To Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-ashton-hagans-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=February 23, 2024|access-date=February 24, 2024}} ===Xinjiang Flying Tigers (2024–2025)=== On September 27, 2024, Hagans signed with the [[Xinjiang Flying Tigers]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]] (CBA).{{cite web|first=Alberto|last=De Roa|title=Ashton Hagans, a former Blazers player, joins Chinese team Xinjiang Flying Tigers for the 2024-25 season.|url=https://hoopshype.com/rumor/3185581/|website=HoopsHype.com|date=September 27, 2024|access-date=September 28, 2024}}{{cite web|author=HoopsChina|title=🇨🇳 @ashton.hagans WELCOME TO CBA 🔥 #CBA #CHINA #XINJIANG #NBA|url=https://www.threads.net/@chnhoops/post/DAcpv5sxv6z|website=Threads.net|date=September 28, 2024|access-date=September 28, 2024}} On August 13, 2025, Hagans signed with the [[Cairns Taipans]] of the [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL) for the [[2025–26 NBL season|2025–26 season]].{{Cite web |title=Five-headed Snake: Cairns' big signing spree |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/cairns-taipans-five-new-signings-nbl26 |access-date=August 13, 2025 |website=nbl.com.au |date=August 13, 2025 |language=en}} He was granted a release from his contract on September 15, prior to the start of the season, due to personal reasons.{{cite web |title=Club Statement: Ashton Hagans |url=https://www.taipans.com/news/club-statement-ashton-hagans |website=Cairns Taipans {{!}} Official NBL Website |access-date=September 15, 2025 |date=September 15, 2025}}
